'''Bernherd''' is the [[tavernkeeper]] of [[The Dead Man's Breath]] in [[Caemlyn]].

==Appearance==
Bernherd is a greasy-haired Tairen with a mouth so small it looked like he had swallowed his lips by mistake. He smells of radishes.{{ref/book|13|8}}
